caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and illustrates a textile fragment with intricate embroidery. The textile consists of two main sections: the left section is composed of a grid of diamond-shaped compartments, each containing a distinct raised pattern such as floral motifs, geometric shapes, and stars, creating a quilted appearance; small dots and lines further embellish each compartment. The right section features a broad border with an undulating vine or fern-like design, punctuated by clusters of raised, circular floral elements. The two sections are separated by a vertical, stitched seam. The edges of the textile are bordered with a narrow decorative trim. The entire composition is set against a light, plain background with some faint discoloration at the edges.
title: Tufted Candlewick Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
